description: This is a React component written in TypeScript, representing a navigation bar (Navbar) for a web application. It includes UI elements such as logo, navigation links, user session actions (login, signup, logout), and a call-to-action button for creating a new post.

methods.name: Navbar
methods.description: React functional component that renders the application's navigation bar based on user session and current URL path.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Helper function to determine if a navigation link corresponds to the current URL path.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Asynchronous function to handle user logout by calling an API endpoint and redirecting to home.
